questions.question: Of the 20 episodes, how many ended with the courier at the customer at (5, 5), as opposed to ending because the 30-step limit was reached?
How many times during the whole execution did GridEnv._arrival_bonus() get called (that is, how many times was the 10.0 arrival reward actually given out)?
What was the value of env.bumps (the counter of moves blocked by a wall or the grid edge) after all 20 episodes had finished?
What was the total number of env.step() calls made over all 20 episodes combined?
Which episode, counting from 1, ended because the 30-step limit was reached rather than at the customer?
questions.format: An integer episode number from 1 to 20, e.g. 7

questions.question: How many steps did the shortest episode of the run take?
How many times in the whole run did the policy function choose() return the action "right"?
What was the highest total return of any single episode in the run?
questions.format: A decimal number rounded to one decimal place, e.g. -3.4
